question: Does a broad CoL XR Actinopterygii search for georeferenced Bataan GBIF records add locality-resolved fish evidence beyond the prior preserved-specimen screen?

priorPreservedSearch.scope: GBIF country=PH, stateProvince=Bataan, CoL XR Actinopterygii, PRESERVED_SPECIMEN; previously retained screen.

method.deduplication: Matched GBIF occurrence keys against the prior 319-row preserved-specimen screen. Non-matching keys are additional index records, not necessarily independent biological observations or specimens.

interpretation.decision: The query broadens the Bataan discovery set but does not provide an independently validated fish record for a named river, lake, reservoir, wetland or coastal reach. The 54 additional iNaturalist observations have no waterBody/locality field in GBIF. The 66 additional NMNH/iBOL material-sample rows have market or vendor-origin statements rather than verified capture stations; some NMNH records carry broad Manila Bay or Philippine Sea waterBody labels, which do not resolve the market samples to a collection site. Keep all candidates research-only.
interpretation.administrativeScope: stateProvince=Bataan is an indexed-text filter, not a polygon intersection or proof that every coordinate falls within the official provincial boundary.
interpretation.coordinates: hasCoordinate and hasGeospatialIssue=false do not guarantee fine-scale accuracy. Keep point coordinates and record IDs in ignored research storage; uncertainty is summarized in broad bins only.
interpretation.sourceType: HUMAN_OBSERVATION, MATERIAL_SAMPLE and PRESERVED_SPECIMEN are not interchangeable. An observation is not automatically a wild capture; material/barcode samples can originate from a market; historical specimens do not establish current presence.
interpretation.imageRights: No image was downloaded, inspected or admitted. iNaturalist record/photo licenses and specimen-media rights require individual review; dataset-level terms do not transfer to each photo by assumption.
interpretation.absence: This bounded GBIF filter is not a complete inventory; unreturned rows do not establish biological absence.

limitations: The administrative filter is GBIF stateProvince text rather than a validated provincial polygon.
This search covers CoL XR Actinopterygii only; it excludes sharks, rays and other fish groups outside that taxonomic concept.
Coordinates and coordinate uncertainty can be generalized, coarse or otherwise unsuitable for assigning a named waterbody.
The 120 keys outside the prior preserved-specimen screen include 54 iNaturalist observations and 66 material samples. Counts are not counts of independent animals or species.
No item-level source identity, capture status, exact waterbody, taxonomic diagnosis or image reuse rights were verified.
nextStep: Prioritize separate source-backed Bataan waterbodies and review any candidate row individually for original collection/observation context, taxon evidence, geoprivacy, coordinate uncertainty and record-level license before promoting a historical research assertion or image.

sources.supports: The exact bounded search request and results recorded in the report; occurrence fields remain candidate evidence.
NMNH Material Samples dataset metadata, including its dataset-level license statement; this does not assign field-level rights or capture provenance to each sample.
iBOL occurrence-dataset metadata and its dataset-level license statement; barcode identifiers are not species determinations.
The iNaturalist Research-grade Observations dataset metadata and its dataset-level CC BY-NC license statement; item/photo rights and locality remain record-specific.
